_comment: Catalog of ready-to-run Android images for android-emu.
Only x86/x86_64 builds can run inside QEMU system-x86_64.
'iso' images boot read-only (no persistence), 'raw'/'qcow2' images keep your changes.
Every entry must be a direct download link to the image file.

images.name: Android-x86 9.0-r2 (live ISO)
images.description: Classic Android 9 for PC, bootable live ISO (changes are not kept)

images.name: Android-x86 8.1-r6 (live ISO)
images.description: Older, very compatible Android 8.1 live ISO

images.name: BlissOS 14 (Android 11, ISO)
images.description: Modern Android 11 desktop experience, heavier (3 GB RAM recommended)

images.name: PrimeOS (Android 11, ISO)
images.description: Android 11 with desktop windowing and multi-window support
